# Find the race that ships an older commit

> Paste a GitHub Actions workflow and see every way it is allowed to apply an older revision over a newer one: no concurrency group, a group that changes every run, cancel-in-progress on a deploy, split groups on one environment, and a checkout of a moving branch. Free, runs entirely in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
